attr.title: Crystal Story Awakening
attr.desc: Crystal Story: Awakening is an Action-RPG that blends charming retro-style graphics with fast-paced action, heavily inspired by 16-bit classics!
attr.inst: Download and extract CS Awakening v2.zip (https://bredfrown.itch.io/crystal-story) into the assets folder of the port folder and run the port, on first startup it will patch the game.
